Programmed Monomachine OS 1.32B dumps for `mmDataCorpusTest`: random but valid
patterns, kits, songs and globals built with the elektronData MM codec by
`mmEditorProbeFirmwareTest program`, sent to the emulated firmware on SYSEX RECV,
and saved as the firmware's raw read-back replies (each equals what was sent).
No factory patterns, sounds or songs.

- `programmed-pattern-000`: 64 steps; `001`: all 62 pooled locks; `002`: MIDI chords (up to 4 notes a step)
- `programmed-song-000`: 199 rows and END (the 200-row maximum)
- `programmed-global-001`, `002`: non-active global slots with random routing mode, tune and MIDI sequencer settings
